title: 4xB200 cross-framework, ComfyUI added (latest-vs-latest)
description: Complete cross-framework round on one 4xB200 devbox: 16 cases, SGLang-Diffusion against vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TRT-LLM VisualGen and (first time) ComfyUI, every framework on its newest line. Adds Qwen-Image-2.1. Single-request latency for every supported cell, throughput for one image and one video case.

benchmark_repo.harness_note: c201f19 is bc439d0 plus the ComfyUI MiniMax-H3 ref2va reference resize; nothing else that measures changed.

frameworks.lightx2v: main a4b8ce30ac73ae561ec9d1a8bc6629e4aed9d2d8 (0.5.0), torch 2.11.0 -- the pin in LightX2V's official image; flash-attn does not build against torch 2.14

merge.rule: build_report_artifacts: a later input replaces an earlier one per (case_id, framework)

replaced.ltx2_twostage_t2v (every framework): run_b200full0925r_ltx2b replaces the main pass, which read a Lightricks/LTX-2 text_encoder/config.json that sglang's LTX-2.3 overlay materializer had rewritten inside the shared model cache on 2026-09-13 (the blob no longer hashed to its own name). sglang read 5.438 s on the rewritten file, 6.048 s on the intact one.
replaced.ltx2.3_twostage_t2v_2gpus (sglang): run_b200full0925r_ltx23b replaces a main-pass server that never became healthy: on the read-only cache the same materializer failed with EROFS. The rerun materialized into a writable private copy of the cache.
replaced.minimax_h3_ref2va_5s (comfyui): run_b200full0925r_ref2va replaces a main-pass cell that fed ComfyUI the reference at its original size while sglang and vLLM-Omni upscale it to a 2048-pixel short edge (343.5 s on about 8x fewer reference tokens).
replaced.ideogram4_t2i_1024_2gpu_tp (comfyui): run_b200full0925r_ideo (2026-09-26, harness 4bfdd99) replaces a main-pass cell that loaded Comfy-Org's fp8_scaled repack. ComfyUI runs such a checkpoint as W8A8 on sm90+ -- activations quantized to FP8 in all 211 linears, 2.7% relative error per linear against weight-only, 1.75x faster GEMMs -- and the repack is per-tensor requantized where the official release scales per row: 3.178 s, a different precision class from the sglang row. The rerun loads the official FP8 release dequantized to BF16 exactly as sglang's weight-only FP8 linears compute it (dequant-fp8: model source): 4.155 s.

files.raw/: original runner output; exactly the merge inputs above
files.failures/run_b200full0925r_ltx2_ltx2_two: first LTX-2 rerun, discarded: it overlapped CPU-heavy work on the box, which slows sglang's mp4 encoding inside the request (sglang 8.767 s against 6.048 s on the clean rerun)
files.failures/run_b200full0925r_ltx23_ltx2.3_: first LTX-2.3 rerun, discarded for the same contention (8.762 s against 7.753 s)
files.evidence/run_abab0925_qwen*_qwen_image_2: ABAB-interleaved sglang/vLLM-Omni paired reruns of qwen_image_2512: sglang 0.7% and 0.8% ahead, against 5.2% behind in the main pass -- a tie
sglang LTX-2 on fresh servers with host CPU sampled, measuring the mp4 save share of client latency
files.merged.json: merged artifact the Pages data was published from
files.issue.md: data-only tracker report with per-cell statuses and reasons
